sources.entry: PlayStatus - PlayStatus is a macOS app that allows the control of Spotify and iTunes music playback from the menu bar.

summary.one_liner: PlayStatus is a native SwiftUI macOS menu bar app for controlling Apple Music and Spotify playback, with a detached player, lyrics, play history, and Last.fm scrobbling.
summary.what_it_does: PlayStatus lives in the macOS menu bar and shows a player for Apple Music and Spotify, with transport controls, a seekable progress bar, and a menu bar text display (artist, song, both, or icon only). It offers regular, mini, and detached floating player modes, with themes and artwork motion styles configurable in Settings. Lyrics (from Apple Music or LRCLIB) and credits open inside the player, and search is provider-aware. A play history keeps up to 5,000 plays on the Mac, and Last.fm scrobbling sends plays once half the track or four minutes has been heard, queuing offline plays. It can also be driven through Shortcuts actions, Spotlight phrases, global hotkeys, and a playstatus:// URL scheme.
use_cases: control Apple Music or Spotify from the menu bar
float a small always-on-top music player on screen
show lyrics and credits for the current song
keep a local history of recently played tracks
trigger playback from Shortcuts, Raycast, Alfred, or Stream Deck
how_to_run: Move PlayStatus to /Applications and launch it
Grant Automation permission to control Music and/or Spotify when macOS asks
notable: Mini, regular, and detached floating player modes with theme presets and artwork motion styles
URL scheme and Shortcuts actions allow control without bringing the app to the foreground
Last.fm session key stored in macOS Keychain; password entered on Last.fm's site, not in the app
Play history stored locally only, capped at 5,000 plays
caveats: Only Apple Music and Spotify are supported; Toggle Favorite works for Apple Music only
Lyrics are third-party content and may be incomplete or unavailable
